subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Battery Recycling
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Battery Recycling.

hook.text: Millions of EV batteries will reach end of life in the next decade—what happens to all that metal?

buildup.text: Recycling recovers lithium, nickel, cobalt, and other valuable metals from spent battery cells.

discovery.text: Hydrometallurgical processes dissolve the cathode in acid and extract each metal for reuse in new cells.

twist.text: Recycled metals can be just as pure as freshly mined ones, creating a true circular supply chain.

climax.text: Redwood Materials and Li-Cycle are building massive recycling plants to handle the coming wave of retired packs.

punchline.text: Tomorrow's batteries will be made from yesterday's batteries.

quiz.question: What can battery recycling recover from spent EV cells?
options: Lithium, nickel, cobalt, and other metals
